findings.title: api can't keep up
findings.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 16/s and handles 16/s (100%): its backlog only grows.

findings.title: Every request goes through one api
findings.message: It runs 1 replica at 100% of what it can handle, and every request from Web goes through it: if it stops or slows, Web gets nothing.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
